about: How AzerothGPS StreetView ships its pictures: standard (SD) packs, one per continent, uploaded to CurseForge as required dependencies of the viewer, so installing the viewer brings them. Every pack's zip stays under budget_bytes (CurseForge refuses files of 2 GB or more). 'spacing_yd' is how far apart the capture PC renders spots (the master keeps them all); 'ship_spacing_yd' is how far apart the packs' spots are (pack.ship_points thins the rendered ones, 2026-09-29: the user chose 200 yd so everything fits in about 1.1 GB). 'planned' is the number of shipped spots expected in that pack (at ship_spacing_yd), for projecting full sizes. The master tiles in build/master are kept at HD resolution; HD packs are not made or shipped for now.
